name: poi-command-photo-ops
note: poi_store Command: op export_photos, replace.photo_dir, replace result counts (photos_replaced, photos_removed)

name: poi-clear-photo-kind
note: poi_store Command.kinds includes photo; clear result {removed, pois, photos}

name: poi-list-photo-entries
note: /poi/list carries photo POIs (photo_as_poi form, x/y may be null) after non-photo POIs; one revision

name: head-rgbd-applied-calibration
note: head_camera_cpp camera_info_file and head_rgbd_cpp tof_calibration_file point at /var/lib/ros2/head_rgbd_calibration/applied/*; committed repo calibration files only seed an empty applied/ (force: false); head_rgbd_cpp config_files entry removed; owner task head-nodes-use-applied-calib

name: head-rgbd-points
note: /head_rgbd/points: PointCloud2 XYZRGB (packed float32 rgb) in the RGB optical frame, RGB stamp, <= cloud.rate_hz (1 Hz), published while subscribed; consumed by ground_estimator_cpp colour labels (task ground-node-wiring)

name: tof-points-filtered
note: /tof/points_filtered: laser_filter self-filtered ToF cloud, tof_optical_frame, ~10 Hz, reliable; ground_estimator_cpp input and ground_clear frustum source (tasks ground-node-wiring, nav2-ground-voxel-layer)

name: nav2-tof-voxel-bands
note: tof_voxel_layer sources/bands and collision_monitor tof_obstacles/tof_cliff stay unchanged; ground_voxel_layer is added alongside; tests/test_nav_tof_voxel_layer.py and tests/test_tof_obstacle_wiring.py checks scoped to tof_voxel_layer (task nav2-ground-voxel-layer)

name: arm-calibration-stale-marker
note: /var/lib/ros2/arm/calibration_stale.json {version:1, group, saved_at, joints:{name:{before_steps,after_steps}}, stale:[joint_offsets, home]}; writer feetech bridge after an arm neutral save; mcp_server removes home on arm_set_home; the arm calibration apply removes joint_offsets; empty list deletes the file; owner task bridge-runtime-neutral-save
